data.long_meaning: The name Baleel is of Arabic origin and is derived from the root verb 'balaa' which means 'to serve'. This name signifies one who is a devoted servant of Allah. Parents who choose Baleel usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
